activity.heading: Activity requirements
activity.lead: To keep the community active and worthwhile, members are expected to:

attend.title: Attend at least 2 gatherings a year.
attend.body: Gatherings include in-person meetings, workshops and social events.

slack.title: Be active in the Slack channel.
slack.body: Join discussions, share experiences and ask questions.

absence.title: Let us know if you will be away.
absence.body: If you know you will be less active for a while, tell the board.

activity.review: The board reviews activity levels regularly. If the requirements are not met over time, the board may get in touch for a conversation about the way forward.

retirement.heading: Retirement
retirement.body: A member who does not meet the activity requirements over a longer period may be retired by the board. Retirement is not a punishment, but a recognition that life and priorities change.

meaning.slack: You keep access to Slack, but lose access to private channels and are moved to a retired role.
meaning.events: You cannot attend roundtable gatherings, but you are welcome at social events.
meaning.vote: You have no vote at the annual general meeting.
meaning.rejoin: You can ask the board at any time to become an active member again.

reinstatement.heading: Rejoining
reinstatement.body: Want to become an active member again? Get in touch with the board. We consider rejoining based on your intent and your capacity to take an active part.

host.title: Hosting
host.intro: Let us know you are interested in hosting. It is not a commitment: the board gets in touch when we plan the next gathering and matches you with a suitable topic and group. The gatherings themselves are booked through Luma.
host.formIntro: All fields are optional: signing up is signal enough. The board sets up the gathering in Luma when it is your turn.

form.capacity: How many people can you host?
form.timeframePlaceholder: e.g. Q3 2026, before the summer, flexible
form.error: Could not register. Please try again.

openToWork.title: Open to work
openToWork.intro: We are regularly asked whether we know someone for a CTO role. If you are in a new situation, or just curious about what is out there, you can mark yourself as open here. By default you are not listed. The list is only visible to members of the investment groups and the board, since that is where the requests come in. You can withdraw at any time.

device.intro: An agent (for example the ctr CLI on a box) is asking for access to the portal's admin API. Check that you started it yourself and that the code matches the one in the terminal. Only then approve.

surveys.intro: Short surveys after our events. They take a couple of minutes, and they are how we find out what worked and what we should do differently next time. The board sees the answers.

sweden.title: CTO Roundtable Sweden
sweden.intro: This is the Stockholm chapter's own space. The evenings and surveys here are for the Swedish chapter only.
sweden.noUpcoming: No evening is set up yet. It will show here and on Luma.
sweden.sharedBody: Offers from partner companies, and investor updates if you are part of an investment cohort.

how.a: An evening every one to two months. One company presents its setup, the host offers pizza and something to drink, and the rest is three hours of honest questions. 10 to 15 CTOs, invite-only.

who.a: CTOs (or the person doing that job), invited by an existing member.

norway.q: How is this related to the Norwegian network?
norway.a: Same model, separate group. Separate evenings, a separate channel, no shared invitations. Offers and the investment side are shared.

question.a: Ask in #roundtable-sweden, or reply to your invitation email.

qa.intro: Ask what you want to know. An agent answers from the material above, usually within a few minutes, and says so when the answer is not there. Then the question goes to the owner of the case. The answer is shown to everyone in the SPV. Only the committee sees who asked.

comments.intro: Do you have objections, suggestions or questions for the founder, or do you know them? Write it here. The committee sees it with your name. The other members do not see it, so nobody is swayed by what others write. It does not count as a vote.

placeholder.suggestion: What should we follow up on, or do differently?

ballot.backfill: Vote by email, closed {date}. Only the counts were recorded.

ballot.standingBlank: You stand as blank until you vote yourself.

ballot.notOnRoster: You are not on the voting list of {group}.
ballot.secret: You see the counts, not who voted what. The committee sees the names. The proposal passes with at least 2/3 yes of the yes and no votes.

ballot.closeNeeds: The proposal passed. Before the vote closes, the ledger needs who drove the case and who takes the follow-up.

conflict.declared: You have declared a conflict ({date}). You can only vote blank on this company.
conflict.lockedWhileOpen: A vote is open now, so it cannot be withdrawn until the vote is over.
conflict.openRoundNote: The vote that is open now has already locked its list of voters. Vote blank there yourself. This applies from the next vote.
conflict.staffLabel: 1 has declared a conflict | {count} have declared a conflict

pipelineDigest.draftIntro: Made by {who}. It goes to everyone in the SPV by email and Slack once a committee member approves it. For the first four weeks the committee approves each one; after that it goes out on its own.

hovedbok.title: Ledger
hovedbok.intro: Who earns the incentive on this investment: {total} % of the gain, {followUp} % to the follow-up, {committee} % to the committee and {drivers} % to whoever drove the case. Only the committee sees this.
hovedbok.introNoModel: Who earns the incentive on this investment. Only the committee sees this.

hovedbok.recordedBy: Saved by {name} when the vote closed.

consent.title: Cookies 🍪
consent.body: Not the edible kind, sadly. We run no ads and sell nothing to anyone. We just want to know which pages you actually use, so we stop building things nobody clicks 😅
consent.fine: Say no and we still count page views, but store nothing in your browser.
